shortDescription: Swap colourful bottles, uncover the secret order and master 50 brain-teasing puzzles.
fullDescription:
Think you can uncover the secret bottle sequence?

In Bottle Shuffle, your challenge is to rearrange colourful bottles until they match a hidden order. Swap any two bottles and watch the match counter to discover how close you are to solving the puzzle.

Start with simple three-bottle challenges and progress towards increasingly challenging ten-bottle puzzles. Complete 50 levels, earn stars, improve your personal bests and sharpen your puzzle-solving skills.

Features:

- 50 puzzles across six difficulty tiers.
- Simple tap-to-swap controls.
- Hidden sequences and aggregate match feedback.
- Interactive tutorial.
- Star ratings and efficiency-based scoring.
- Personal best records.
- Unlimited randomised practice.
- Colourful bottle designs with distinctive symbols.
- Landscape and portrait gameplay.

Swap. Match. Master.
accessibilitySummary: Colour-blind friendly bottle symbols paired with distinct colours
Numeric and directional match feedback (not colour alone)
OS and in-game Reduced Motion support
